QF.id: AIFM CIII Governance and Due Diligence_9

question.text: Subscription and redemption documents for a Cat III open-ended AIF scheme must typically include which of the following investor-facing items?

answer.text: Contribution Agreement, Investor Charter reference, PPM acknowledgment, KYC/FATCA declarations and redemption notice mechanics
Distributor commission schedule and MFN side-letter mandatorily appended
SEBI circular text printed verbatim in full

explanation.text: The Logic: Subscription and redemption documentation for a Cat III open-ended scheme typically bundles: the contribution/subscription agreement, the Investor Charter reference, PPM acknowledgment with PPM-aligned subscription terms, KYC/CKYCR and FATCA/CRS declarations, and redemption conditions/gates per the PPM. These operationalise the governance disclosures and investor-facing requirements. The Trap: Distributor commission schedules are disclosed but not typically appended; MFN side-letters are case-by-case. SEBI circulars are referenced, not embedded verbatim. Trustee personal net-worth is not an investor-facing requirement. Note: Pages 112, 229, 237, 430, and 440-441 of the workbook describe the investor-facing document bundle, the Investor Charter, PPM-aligned subscription terms, redemption conditions/gates, KYC/CKYCR, and FATCA/CRS declarations.
